firm_data.firm_description: Gish PLLC is an intellectual property law firm specializing in complex cases involving patents, trade secrets, copyrights, trademarks, false advertising, and contracts. They represent startups and multinational corporations, delivering results at a fraction of the cost of Big Law.
notable_facts: Attorneys are former Big Law litigators.
Almost every member of the team holds a technical degree.
Offices in New York and San Francisco.
The firm offers cutting-edge IP litigation and counseling.

email.subject: AI for Gish PLLC, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Andrew,

Your team's background as former Big Law litigators, combined with deep technical expertise across patents and trade secrets, positions Gish PLLC to compete at the highest level. We're noticing that boutique IP firms like yours need tools that match BigLaw capability without the overhead.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built specifically for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters to practices like yours: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
